title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Japanese Derby. Meisho Doto's rival of the hour, Admire Vega, pays her no attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega remains focused on seizing the winner's star in dedication to her departed sister. Meisho Doto can only look on in fear.
